def find_groups(stones: set, player: int, board_size=19) -> List[dict]:

    groups = []
    visited = set()
    for stone in stones:
        if stone in visited: continue
        # BFS
        queue = [stone]
        group_stones = set([stone])
        liberties = set()
        visited.add(stone)
        while queue:
            cur = queue.pop()
            # check neighbors
            for nb in get_neighbors(cur):
                if nb in stones and nb not in visited: queue.append(nb); visited.add(nb); group_stones.add(nb)
                elif nb not in board or board[nb] != player: liberties.add(nb)
        # group_stones and liberties
        groups.append({'stones': group_stones, 'libs': liberties})
    return groups

def find_groups(stones: set, player: int) -> List[dict]:
    visited = set()
    groups = []
    for stone in stones:
        if stone not in visited:
            queue = [stone]
            visited.add(stone)
            group_stones = set([stone])
            libs = set()
            while queue:
                cur = queue.pop()
                for nb in neighbors(cur):
                    if nb in stones and nb not in visited:
                        visited.add(nb)
                        queue.append(nb)
                        group_stones.add(nb)
                    elif nb not in board or board[nb] != player:
                        libs.add(nb)
            groups.append({'stones': group_stones, 'libs': libs})
    return groups
